fertilizers.reason: Phosphorus: soil P is rated low, so the standard 50 kg P2O5/ha is adjusted to 125% = 62.5 kg/ha. DAP is the P source and also supplies some N.
Nitrogen: soil N is rated low, so the standard 100 kg N/ha is adjusted to 125% = 125.0 kg/ha. Urea covers what DAP does not (100.5 kg N/ha).
Potassium: soil K is rated medium, so the standard 50 kg K2O/ha is adjusted to 100% = 50.0 kg/ha.

alternatives.option: Single super phosphate instead of DAP
alternatives.note: SSP supplies phosphorus (and sulphur) but no nitrogen, so urea covers the full N target.

rules_status: APPROXIMATE general values for Indian conditions. NOT verified against a specific publication.
